say:1:1322552001:1.text: I'll make sure they're locked up, and I'll have the temple come to purify and counsel them.
say:1:1322552001:1.source_cn: 我会马上将这些邪教徒关押进监狱，并且请教会的人来做净化...

say:2:1322552002:1.text: It'll take a while, but at least they won't be causing any more trouble.
say:2:1322552002:1.source_cn: 虽然辅导的过程非常漫长……但至少这群人不会再乱跑造成混乱了。

say:3:1322552003:1.text: Thank you for all your help. Without you, we'd have a real mess on our hands trying to keep things in order here.
say:3:1322552003:1.source_cn: 感谢您的协助。如果没有您，我们真的很难在这么短的时间内...
